Privacy Notice

How we handle your data for the Osmos Alpha.

1. The Data We Collect

We collect your email address when you voluntarily submit it to join the waitlist. Additionally, to protect our services against automated spam, our backend logs connection metadata (such as your User-Agent string, preferred languages, and an anonymized IP address where the last octet is fully masked).

2. How We Use Your Data

We use your email address exclusively to send waitlist confirmations, onboarding setup guides, and development updates. The anonymized connection metadata is processed strictly for security validation (honeypot and bot detection) and rate limiting.

3. Cookies & Preferences

We utilize standard local storage and essential cookies to store your preferences (such as dark mode choice, waitlist signup status, and cookie consent). No advertising, profiling, or cross-site tracking cookies are set.

4. Security & Third-Party Sharing

Your email is transmitted securely using standard TLS encryption and processed through our Google Workspace SMTP relays. We store subscriber records securely on encrypted database clusters. We never sell, rent, or share your data with third parties.

5. Your Rights & Opt-out

You retain full control over your data. If you wish to opt-out or request immediate deletion of your email and associated records from our systems, simply email us at support@useosmos.com.
